rationale: S-0039-01 proposes rerunning the t0039 7-diameter sweep on t0024 for active-vs-passive testbed comparison. Both t0022 and t0024 substrates have been de-emphasised since brainstorm 9. The active-vs-passive dendrite question (research question Q4) should be addressed on the from-scratch substrate with explicit per-segment Nav/Kv toggling. Reprioritising from high to medium pending that future active-dendrite track on the from-scratch substrate.
